Second-pass mobile-controls audit for the Onslaught source reconstruction. Your first proposal incorrectly assumed the production mobile-controls.js interface matched the reconstructed game's window.game API. It does not: production mobile-controls.js expects game.input.keys, pressed, mouseDown, mousePressed, dx, dy, wheel, locked/lock/unlock and checks game.state === 'playing', while reconstructed main.js exposes a state object and currently only has a keys Set internally. You now have the production mobile-controls.js, mobile-fire-look.js, mobile-settings.js and mobile-controls.css as READ-ONLY reference context. Do not patch those production asset files. Design the smallest robust fix for the source reconstruction: either provide a compatible adapter or implement a reconstruction-specific touch bridge, whichever is safer and simpler. Requirements: no double-tap/page zoom during gameplay, no pull-to-refresh/scroll stealing combat touches, usable movement/look/fire/ADS/reload/slide/weapon switching, safe-area-aware HUD/control placement, no desktop pointer-lock regression, no hidden infinite waits, no UI tap leaking into fire, and no claims that tests were run. Return a unified diff only for changes you can justify from the supplied code, plus exact build/smoke/manual tests for GPT-5.6 Sol.
